{"subject":"Meridian x Apex: recap of today's validation and next steps","body":"Hi Aisha, Leo and Nora,

Thanks for the time today. Here is where we landed.

Shown: the readmission pipeline ran on your de-identified extract in nine minutes, with the top three drivers on each row and score restatement when late claims arrive.

Open on SSO: mhp_roles is a nested claim, and Apex maps flat claims today. Nested claims are in private preview with no announced general availability date. Marcus will take this to our identity team today and get Leo something he can put in front of Raj.

From us: Marcus will send Nora the encryption whitepaper. I will check what we can share of the recording and come back to Nora. We will send the security packet to Aisha, copying Raj, ahead of the October 9th committee.

From you: procurement sends the vendor questionnaire.

If useful, would a call after Marcus sends the SSO answer help, or is email enough?

Jordan","customer_value_line":"The incremental pipeline is aimed at moving your readmission risk list from weekly to daily so care managers can call patients the morning after discharge.","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U027","excerpt":"If a care manager gets the list the morning after discharge, they can call while the patient still remembers who we are."},{"utterance_id":"U028","excerpt":"Last night's run took nine minutes."},{"utterance_id":"U016","excerpt":"Today this takes a flat claim.
